ecthr_a.text: paragraphs joined by two newline characters
ecthr_a.labels: 10 stored violation indicators plus derived no_violation indicator

20_newsgroups.text: dataset's pre-cleaned text (headers, footers, and quotes removed); canonical empty rows are retained as one CLS/SEP-only empty-sequence leaf with zero raw-token mass

classification.selection_metric: validation_micro_f1 over 11 labels; ties choose smaller C
classification.refit: train plus validation at selected C, exactly one test evaluation

clustering.samples: concatenated canonical train then test splits

direct_teacher_policy: Computed only for raw-token length <= max_position_embeddings-2. Included in a downstream task only if every task row is valid; otherwise coverage is reported and it is not evaluated, preserving identical samples and forbidding silent drops.
cache_policy: Each nonempty document's exact contiguous 1024-raw-token normalized-CLS leaf tensor is materialized once. Canonical empty cleaned documents are retained as one normalized CLS/SEP-only leaf with zero raw-token mass. Every recursive checkpoint and both averaging baselines load the same tensor bytes and offsets.
